02 / Black Rose
						Bloom under a Bay Bridge moon.
						Black is not absence. It is depth, protection, and elegance with its guard up. The rose survives because it knows its own value—and never asks a shadow for permission to bloom.
						Enter Black Rose→

04 / Kids Capsule
						The throne is already hers.
						Kids Capsule is not a smaller version of the house. It is the first room built for the next generation: confidence, imagination, and enough space to picture themselves at the center of the story.
